evidence.ACL: Complete tear of the anterior cruciate ligament, at mid substance.
evidence.MCL: Chronic sprain of the medial collateral ligament.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: longitudinal vertical tear at the body and complex tear at the posterior horn of the medial meniscus.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: horizontal tear at the anterior horn, body and posterior horn of the lateral meniscus.
evidence.Medial OA: focal low grade chondrosis (less than 50% thickness cartilage loss) at the posteromedial tibial plateau
evidence.PF OA: diffuse low grade and high grade chondrosis (less than and more than 50% thickness cartilage loss) at the medial, lateral patellar facets, medial and lateral trochleas.
evidence.Effusion: Large amount of right knee effusion
evidence.Baker's: 2* intact8* 2.8 cm baker's cyst at the posteromedial tibial plateau.
evidence.Contusion: subchondral bone bruise at the posterolateral tibial plateau.
